title: Rational Relapse Theory Archive v4.0: Axiomatic Endogenous-Recovery Structural Model
description: Archival release of the June 2026 manuscript stage originally labeled v6.2. This version develops an axiomatic endogenous-recovery structural model within rational addiction. The release preserves the original Chinese manuscript together with an English archival companion and provenance metadata. Later archive versions revise both the terminology and the claimed contribution; this record is retained as a historical stage rather than as the author's current theoretical position.
